en: Colorized historic postcard view of a landscaped public square with a central flowerbed bordered by low fencing, surrounded by lawns, trees, and paths. In the background are several ornate multi‑story buildings with mansard roofs and decorative façades. The sky is blue with scattered clouds. Red printed captions identify the location as Riesa on the Elbe River and the specific square as Kaiser‑Wilhelm‑Platz.
